meta.scope: Read-only XAU/USD research control surface. It does not qualify live calls or alter live weights.

release_gate.title: XAU/USD remains unqualified until every gate passes
requirements: Use exact MT5-aligned call timestamps, broker symbols, bid/ask prices, spread, session boundaries, and the published standard and 0.5 L2L levels.
Assess every individual algorithm element, then combinations and correlation clusters, before proposing any weight change.
Prove the full algorithm with an explicit entry, target, adverse-boundary, and sequencing contract on unseen time-ordered data.
Treat reach rate as research context only. It is not trade expectancy or evidence that a live call should be released.

performance.label: Call gate
performance.detail: MT5 alignment and executable risk contract required

todo.title: Establish the XAU/USD level contract
todo.detail: Capture the standard L2L and 0.5 L2L levels known at each published call, with the exact timestamp.

todo.title: Provide an MT5 data export or read-only feed
todo.detail: Needed: broker symbol, timezone, bid/ask OHLC, spread, timeframe, session boundary, call timestamp, and published L2L levels.

todo.title: Assess every XAU/USD algorithm element
todo.detail: Measure standalone directional value, coverage, stability, and correlation before any re-weighting.

todo.title: Assess element combinations
todo.detail: Test agreement, conflict, and highly correlated clusters on a sealed holdout.

todo.title: Validate the full executable algorithm
todo.detail: Blocked until the entry, target, adverse boundary, and intraday path are defined from real market data.

stages.label: Directional reach baseline
stages.evidence: Historical 1H research compares the existing L2L distance with its 0.5 equivalent using frozen directional calls.
stages.next_action: Keep these reach results separate from trade expectancy until a risk contract exists.

stages.label: Signal and failure audit
stages.evidence: Signal construction, directional discrimination, and failure diagnostics have been produced as research artifacts.
stages.next_action: Use the audit to define the element inventory for the XAU/USD assessment.

stages.label: Individual elements
stages.evidence: XAU/USD is the first focused market for per-element reliability and correlation assessment.
stages.next_action: Measure each input independently before combining or re-weighting factors.

stages.label: Combinations and correlation
stages.evidence: No correlated cluster should be mistaken for independent confirmation.
stages.next_action: Test interactions and remove duplicate influence before evaluating the composite.

stages.label: Executable trade validation
stages.evidence: The current contract does not establish an intraday publication time or adverse boundary/stop sequencing.
stages.next_action: Use MT5-aligned price paths and L2L levels to lock the executable contract.

stages.label: Call qualifying gate
stages.evidence: A reliable strength grade needs calibrated evidence, robust weighting, and executable validation.
stages.next_action: Require all gates to pass before any production call qualification is considered.
